info.title: Silent Issue Tracker API
info.description: An anonymous backend for issue/ticket submission and tracking. No user-identifying information is stored.

get.description: Health check endpoint for the backend.

post.description:
Submit a new anonymous ticket.

- No user-identifying data is stored.
- Returns a public ticket code for later status checking.

get.summary: Get ticket status by public code
get.description:
Retrieve minimal status about a ticket using its public code/ID.
Only non-identifying info is returned.

get.summary: View minimal ticket history (no user info)
get.description:
Returns minimal data about the most recent tickets (for history view).
No identifying/user info is ever returned.

ticket_id.title: Ticket Id
ticket_id.description: Public ticket ID/code for status checks (do NOT expose internals)

created_at.description: Timestamp when the ticket was created

TicketStatusResponse.description: Response containing the status of a ticket.
